_about: One-line descriptions and display names for the Madden 27 persona DNA traits shown in the player profile. All of it is the game's own text: the PersonaDNA enum table inside the legacy franchise data blob common/franchise/frantkdata/0/franchise-tuning-binary (an FTC file, zlib-deflated; each row is description NUL display-name), exported with the MMC Frosty Editor's Legacy Explorer on 2026-09-06. Note the game labels Diva as 'Particular'. The 'focus' block is the PersonaFocus enum from the same file (the player's Active Mindset Focus, one of four, stored at 0xf2 of the M27 draft record).

descriptions.TeamFirst: Chooses team fit over personal gain.
descriptions.WinAtAllCosts: Will take risks to secure a win.
descriptions.Diva: Wants attention, status, and special treatment.
descriptions.Mentor: Cares about legacy and helping teammates.
descriptions.StudentOfTheGame: Focused on improving skills and knowledge.
descriptions.Accountable: Takes responsibility and expects clear roles and trust.
descriptions.Aggressive: Pushes hard for the best deal and quick results.
descriptions.Ambitious: Wants to grow fast and chase bigger opportunities.
descriptions.Approachable: Easy to talk to and open during negotiations.
descriptions.Assertive: Clearly says what he wants and stands firm.
descriptions.Calculated: Thinks through risks before making decisions.
descriptions.Cerebral: Focuses on long-term plans over emotions.
descriptions.Charismatic: Uses personality to influence teams and deals.
descriptions.Collaborative: Looks for win-win deals with the team.
descriptions.OverlyCompetitive: Needs to win negotiations at all costs.
descriptions.Composed: Stays calm and avoids rash decisions.
descriptions.Confident: Believes in his value and won't settle.
descriptions.Conscientious: Pays close attention to contract details.
descriptions.Contractminded: Cares most about money, terms, and structure.
descriptions.Demanding: Expects strong offers and big concessions.
descriptions.Direct: Gets straight to the point in negotiations.
descriptions.Disciplined: Sticks to a plan and avoids impulsive moves.
descriptions.Emotional: Decisions are influenced by feelings and mood.
descriptions.Flexible: Willing to adjust terms and plans.
descriptions.Focused: Blocks out distractions and stays locked in.
descriptions.Frugal: Prefers security and saving over flashy deals.
descriptions.Guarded: Keeps information private and trusts slowly.
descriptions.Headstrong: Resists pressure and rarely backs down.
descriptions.Independent: Values freedom and control over his career.
descriptions.Inquisitive: Asks questions and digs into offers.
descriptions.Intense: Brings urgency and pressure to negotiations.
descriptions.Leader: Considers team impact and leadership role.
descriptions.Loyal: Prefers staying with teams he trusts.
descriptions.Observant: Picks up on details others miss.
descriptions.Opportunistic: Acts fast when a good chance appears.
descriptions.Passionate: Driven by emotion and love for the game.
descriptions.Patient: Willing to wait for the right offer.
descriptions.Principled: Sticks to values and won't cross lines.
descriptions.Reserved: Keeps goals private and reveals little.
descriptions.Resilient: Bounces back and stays firm after setbacks.
descriptions.Selfless: Puts team success above personal gain.
descriptions.Sensitive: Strongly reacts to tone and criticism.
descriptions.Strategic: Plans moves to support long-term goals.
descriptions.Stubborn: Very hard to change his mind.
descriptions.Uncompromising: Refuses to bend on key demands.
descriptions.Wary: Cautious and needs proof before trusting.

LoveOfTheGame.label: Love of the Game
LoveOfTheGame.description: This player loves the sport of football and will do anything to keep playing the sport they love.

Winning.label: Winning
Winning.description: This player cares about winning and being part of an organization that constantly tries to field contending teams.

PersonalAccolades.label: Personal Accolades
PersonalAccolades.description: This player cares about being the best they can be and wants opportunities to prove that.

Financial.label: Financial
Financial.description: This player cares about making the most money and having outside of football fame opportunities.
